metadata.description: HiQ service plugins with native CLI operating guides.

plugins.name: cortex-org-wiki
plugins.description: Search Nora's published organization Wiki and read versioned pages with source citations. Use the CLI's own Cortex login and the intended organization.

plugins.name: hiq-editor
plugins.description: HiQ Editor toolkit: the native CLI release, its canonical UPR workflow skill and evidence-based authoring/review agents.

plugins.name: querying-lca-datasets-expert
plugins.description: Query LCA process datasets and match inventory requirements using the self-contained querying-lca-datasets CLI, with provenance and representativeness review.

plugins.name: jimu-lca
plugins.description: Inspect JiMULCA product carbon-footprint cases and run authorized inventory, binding and calculation operations with the user's own member credential.

plugins.name: cortex-lca-expert
plugins.description: Preview wrapper for cortex-lca-expert 0.1.0-dev.14: build, inspect and calculate openLCA models using the user's installed application and Cortex expert authorization. Wrapper version 0.1.0 is not a stable CLI release.

plugins.name: cortex-epd
plugins.description: Demo-only prerelease wrapper for cortex-epd 0.1.0-dev.14.candidate.39933331655.1.2. EPD pre-audit instructions come from that complete candidate. HOLD remains in effect; this is not promotion, product acceptance or certification.
